message.content: The incident has been escalated to the DPO for a human decision due to a conflict regarding whether data was disclosed outside the controller [F03]. The severity is assessed as 5.25 (very_high) based on the involvement of special categories of data, the lack of encryption rendering data intelligible if accessed, and the disclosure conflict [F02][F04][F03]. Under GDPR Art. 33(1) and Art. 34(1), this severity level indicates a risk to rights and freedoms and a likely high risk to data subjects [F02][F04][F03]. The provisional decision is to notify the supervisory authority and the affected individuals [F03].
